title: Möbius Laundromat
summary: A fluorescent laundromat corridor whose washers rotate the coordinate system and return the camera mirrored.

title: Event Horizon Municipal Pool
summary: A public pool where the water surface is a black threshold and lane lines bend toward it.

title: Recursive Motel Ice Machine
summary: A motel vending alcove repeated through modulo space until the ice machine becomes a portal engine.

title: Underwater Church Basement
summary: A low-ceiling fellowship hall filled with impossible submerged air and sideways buoyancy.

title: Infinite School Hallway of Late Bells
summary: Lockers and tile floors repeat, scale, and misalign while the horizon refuses to stay level.

title: Planetarium Stomach
summary: A dome room that maps stars onto digestive folds and makes celestial navigation feel biological.

title: Anti-Perspective Arcade
summary: Cabinets grow larger as they recede, scanlines become architecture, and the vanishing point comes forward.

title: Glass Elevator Inside the Wall
summary: A transparent elevator shaft embedded in a wall, moving through rooms that should not fit there.

title: Fungal Boiler Room
summary: Industrial pipes softened by mycelial SDF growth, steam that behaves like memory fog.

title: Sigil Drain Atrium
summary: A grand atrium whose floor drain is a polar-coordinate sigil pulling walls inward.

title: Black Sun Observatory
summary: A raymarched observatory where the telescope looks at a sun-shaped absence that lights the room backwards.

title: Hyperbolic Fast-Food Playplace
summary: Plastic tubes and ball pits arranged with hyperbolic scale; every crawl tunnel contains more room than the outside.
